Hi Alice — great questions. Quick answers below:

1) SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report immediately. No NDA required for the redacted copy; full report requires a standard NDA. I'll attach the redacted file in my next email and place it in the shared folder.
2) Encryption: Yes — all customer data is encrypted at rest by default using AES-256. We integrate with AWS KMS and support customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private customers. See the attached instruction doc for how we document keys.
3) Data residency: We support US-only hosting for PHI/HIPAA workloads (US East/West). EU hosting is available but would require a data processing agreement. For AcmeCorp HIPAA scope, we'll keep data in US regions.
4) Ownership: Noted — we'll CC security@acmecorp.com on all responses. Internally, Marissa Cole (marissa_cole) will own technical responses; I'll manage the timeline and coordination.

Turnaround: once we receive a completed SIG worksheet, Marissa expects 5-7 business days for technical review and any clarifying Qs. If you want us to pre-fill non-technical sections, we can do that to speed things up.
